The '''v-90 Protector''' was a model of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] produced by the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the purpose of planetary defense. One of three popular models from KDY's v-series it was considered a medium ion cannon, with a surface-to-low orbit capability useful against [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], and was a common weapon emplacement used to defend various strongholds. The Protector required a crew of ten to operate at full capacity but could get by with a skeleton crew of four.<ref name="HS" />
